info.title: FireWatch Data Intelligence
info.description: Connect to FireWatch for data analytics. Authenticate by providing your organisation's FireWatch URL and an API key that you have generated for your FireWatch user account. Learn more about FireWatch: https://learnprogroup.com/firewatch/.

get.description: Returns the data from executing the named Analytics View.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Analytics View to be executed.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return per request.

parameters.name: pageIndex
parameters.description: Page number of the current request.

parameters.name: organisation-domain
parameters.description: Your organisation's domain which is hosting FireWatch.

200.description: DTO from successfully executing the Analytics View.

view.description: Name of the Analytics View to which the data pertains.

name.description: Name of the row property that correlates to this column. Rows are found in the 'rows' property of the response.

columnName.description: Database column that correlates to this column.

caption.description: User friendly name of the column.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages found by the Analytics View. pageCount will not be present in the response if the request did not specify a pageSize and pageIndex.

rowCount.description: Total number of rows found by the Analytics View. rowCount will not be present in the response if the request did not specify a pageSize and pageIndex.

items.description: Properties will vary, depending on which fields the user has selected for the Analytics View.

rows.description: List of rows, containing the data returned by the Analytics View.

401.description: Invalid access token provided or insufficient access to FireWatch analytics.

get.description: Returns the names of the Analytics Views to which the user has access. Only one Analytics View should be executed at the user's request, and not all.

parameters.name: organisation-domain
parameters.description: Your organisation's domain which is hosting FireWatch.

200.description: Lists the names of the Analytics Views to which the user has access.

name.description: Name of an Analytics View to which the user has access.

401.description: Invalid access token provided or insufficient access to FireWatch analytics.
